p.d: When Lois McMillen, a Connecticut artist was found dead on the British Virgin Island of Tortola in January 2000, four young American tourists were charged with her brutal murder.

A report on George Wright, who was sentenced to prison for the 1962 murder of New Jersey service station owner Walter Patterson, and who after spending 8 years in prison, escaped, and spent 40 years on the run from the authorities.

The dangers of anonymous chat apps; a father discovers his 15-year-old daughter planning to run away with a 30-year-old man she met online; a teenage girl is found stabbed to death after making friends online.
Identical twin brothers suspected of committing a murder after studying a crime show on TV.

The 2010 murder investigation of 23-year-old dancer Julie Kibuishi in Southern California, and how her friend Sam Herr, became the prime suspect in the case until investigators encountered an aspiring actor with a horrific tale to tell.

At 16 Mindy Berenyi, an Antwerp, Ohio girl claiming to be a victim of physical and psychological abuse, was tried for the murder of her father and, having agreed to a plea bargain, was sentenced to prison
Stella Nickell of Auburn, Washington, was sentenced to 90 year in federal prison for poisoning her husband Bruce and Sue Snow, a Seattle bank manager with cyanide-laced Excedrin.

A report on the moral dilemma faced by Jim Morel, a Massachusetts musician, who was told by another musician friend, Jason Weir, that the 2001 death of Marina Calabro, the aunt of their bandmate Anthony Calabro, though ruled an accident, was murder.

Steve Tauzer, a prominent assistant district attorney in Kern County, CA, was found murdered in his garage. Chris Hillis, a former police officer, a colleague and friend of Tauzer, was arrested for the murder. Chris’ son Lance was key to the case.

In July 2008, Michael Roseboro called 911 to report that he had just found the body of his wife, Jan, at the bottom of their pool. An autopsy revealed that she had been strangled, beaten and then drowned: her death was ruled a homicide.

A fire that ignited in an abandoned warehouse in Worcester, Massachusetts in 1999, claimed the lives of six firefighters. A homeless couple living in the building, were subsequently charged with manslaughter for starting the blaze.

In December 2003, the Whitaker family-- Kent, his wife Tricia, and their sons, Bart and Kevin-- returned home from dinner. Upon entering the house, Kevin and Tricia were fatally shot. The investigation revealed that the murders had been planned by Bart.
A report on new details into the search for Natalee Holloway, a U.S. teenager who disappeared on May 30, 2005 during a post-graduation trip in the Caribbean island of Aruba.
In the investigation of the murder of a one-time millionaire, both his ex-wife and his son are suspects.
Charles Forshee, a 56-year-old foster father in Houston, Texas, was charged with the asphyxiation-murder, on June 21, 2001, of Dillon Ferrar, a child in his care.

A crash landing on a strange planet leaves Tyr with a complete loss of memory and a mystery crate to protect from not-so-brotherly Nietzcheans.
Dylan is taken captive and forced to admit that he killed the Mobius leader and overthrew the Mobius government more than 300 years ago.
Harper finds himself overloaded with information when a dying Perseid transfers data into his brain.
Rev Bem receives a call from his friend requiring aid for his people whose settlement will be destroyed by slavers.
A survivor of a destroyed ship, an android named Gabriel, is brought on board the Andromeda.
A humanoid robot visits the Andromeda crew, helps them fight off a culture of organized machines and learns what it means to be a living being.
Beka pilots the Andromeda through slipstream routes that possibly lead to Dylan’s home planet, Tarn-Vedra.
A marriage is arranged between competing Nietzschean Prides in an attempt to bring peace, Captain Hunt transporting the bride to the ceremony.
Trance, Harper and their former employer Gerentex are unwilling partners on a wild ride to find a valuable artifact.
When Harper accidentally overrides Andromeda's personality with an older version, she hunts down the crew and goes on an old mission in which her former crew was slaughtered.
With the ship severely damaged, Dylan leads the crew of the Andromeda Ascendant in a battle against the largest and deadliest enemy they have ever encountered.
Dylan, Beka, Rev Bemand Tyr, pursued by a gang of Neitzscheans, are forced to make a crash landing on an icy planet.
The crew of the Andromeda replaces a sacred relic with a fake, attempting to negotiate peace between two battling parties.
Rommie discovers prejudices toward A.I.s while attempting to expose the nefarious plots of the Machenites.
A stranger with a message from Dylan’s long-dead fiancée arrives onboard Andromeda, leading the crew on a diplomatic mission.
Charlie sleeps with a recovering sex addict.
Charlie receives an unusual payment. Meanwhile; Sean and Michael get into a dating mishap.
A disturbed patient joins Charlie's therapy group.
Charlie causes trouble when he sleeps with Sean's ex.
Charlie offers immoral dating advice to Lacey.
Charlie asks for a second chance with the woman to whom he lost his virginity.
Charlie is pursued by a reporter who is interested in his sex study.
Charlie's bad-girl patient gets sentenced to house arrest and moves in with Charlie.
Ed derails Charlie's plans for Christmas.
Charlie seeks his prison group's help when his partying ways result in him getting arrested.
Jordan does an unusual favor for Charlie.
Charlie sleeps with Jordan's twin sister.
Charlie and Sean compete for the same woman's affection.
Charlie tries to tempt his best party buddy when he becomes a priest.
A forbidden romance tempts Charlie.
Tony and his friend, world-renowned chef Eric Ripert, explore the far reaches of indigenous Andes in search of a rare variety of wild cocoa that is said to be the best in the world.
Tony explores the other Hawaii, the one that those eight million tourists don’t see when they come to the islands. He discovers the fabric of a true cultural mixing pot.
Tony dives into the state of Punjab, India, starting off in Amritsar.
In this episode of Parts Unknown, we first visit the city of Glasgow, then we head north into the Scottish Highlands.
Tony explores what Burroughs called Interzone, where artists sought escape from Western moral prohibitions and the possibilities of great empty spaces. But what is it like now?
The two funniest and most brilliant chef/restaurateurs in Canada, Joe Beef's Dave McMillan and Fred Morin, take Tony across Canada by rail.
After eight years, Tony returns to South Korea. And this time, he’s no stranger to kimchi. But just as Tony has changed, so has Korea.

Sicily isn’t about fast food or the fast life. It’s about savoring family, life, food and making the most of what you have. Tony will go in search of those foods and their producers and eat his way around the island.
The Bronx is burning, became the defining image of New York City in the 70s. Politicians used it as a backdrop illustrate the dire situation in America’s cities while local officials let it burn

In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony travels back to his homeland, his roots, his favorite state in the union: New Jersey. Part nostalgia, part cautionary tale. Tony makes sure to hit up some NJ classics.
Bourdain looks at the Congo as one of the more industrialized powers in Africa now largely crumbled to nothingness and chaos with Tim Butcher author of Blood River.

Israel, the West Bank and Gaza are three locations Tony has never travelled to before.The intense and fraught relationship between these places is hard to understand but Tony will attempt to delve into the lives of those who live here, through their food.
Tony travels to Mexico City and Oaxaca to meet who fight for the food, the art, and the lives they believe in. In the Santa Anita neighbourhood of Mexico City, Tony meets boxer Jorge Lacierva.
Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

Tony travels to Las Vegas Nevada with his food author friend Michael Ruhlman. Whatever your need, whatever bad behaviour you’d like to display Las Vegas is the place that will allow it... for a price.
Fiona and the team return to RAF Marham in Norfolk where finds include a statue of Buddha.

Fiona Bruce and the team head to Polesden Lacey in Surrey and discover a valuable rat deterrent, a glove believed to have belonged to Elizabeth I, and a brooch which was kept hidden for years whilst the owner was in a prisoner of war camp.
A return visit to Wightwick Manor near Wolverhampton for Fiona Bruce and the experts; discoveries include two drawings made by one of Britain's greatest artists JMW Turner.
Fiona Bruce and the team are at Eastbourne Bandstand; family treasures featured include a collection of pottery with a moving story.
Fiona Bruce and the experts pay a second visit to East Sussex as they welcome thousands of visitors to Eastbourne Bandstand.
Objects include artifacts relating to the Nuremberg trials at the end of World War II.

Fiona Bruce and the experts pay a second visit to East Sussex as they welcome thousands of visitors to Eastbourne Bandstand; objects include rare spoons found in pig swill and a bangle left behind by a Russian Princess.
Objects include what could be the most valuable picture ever seen on the show, and a tea caddy.
Fiona Bruce and the experts pay a visit to Newstead Abbey; among the discoveries are a medal for bravery awarded to a pigeon in World War Two.
Fiona Bruce and the team arrive at Towneley Hall near Burnley in Lancashire; despite heavy rain, thousands arrive to show their family treasures.

Fiona Bruce and the team head to Scotland where a large crowd awaits the experts at the National Gallery of Modern Art in Edinburgh; objects include a small carved ivory figure from the 18th century and an original manuscript by Robert Burns.
Fiona Bruce looks back on the most talked about finds of 2013 with updates on star items from the year.
Traveling to Berlin and Bletchley Park to mark the 80th anniversary of Victory in Europe Day; featuring interviews with veterans and the stories of those who helped liberate Europe.
Visiting the National Memorial Arboretum in Staffordshire for the 80th anniversary of VJ Day, featuring interviews with veterans and the stories of those who took part.
Visiting Shuttleworth House in Bedfordshire, where treasures include a diamond necklace, props from the James Bond films and an umbrella stand made from a boat.
Suzanne enlists in a salsa-dancing class with Nick, but her controlling nature soon becomes an issue.
Suzanne helps a professional baseball player develop a charity event, but Nick is thrown a curve when he gets jealous of the two being together. Ice Cube and Jaleel White guest star.
Kevin gets roped into taking a test for a peer, spinning into motion various complications.
Suzanne reaches out to a relationship expert, then comes to believe that she and Nick have compatibility issues.
When Suzanne gets tired of playing the role of bad cop to Nick's good cop, she makes it Nick's job to say No to the kids for an entire week.
Nick runs into an old college friend, who convinces him to bring Deion Sanders aboard his energy drink business – with humiliating consequences.
Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, but the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.
Former child star Todd Bridges guides Lindsey on a wild odyssey to teach her the dangers of drug use. Ice Cube, Charlie Murphy and Jerry Springer also guest star.
Suzanne insists that everyone in the family tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.
Suzanne's book group and Nick's boxing-match party collide in the family room on the same night, resulting in knock-out clashing.
Suzanne suspects that Nick may have fathered his ex-flame's son. Ice Cube and Kandi Burruss guest star.
Nick flops in his efforts to help Kevin with Valentine's Day at school.
Suzanne serves on a committee at Kevin's school, but complications arise when her fellow female members disrespect her---but adore Nick.
When Nick misleads Suzanne about spending a gift card, the couple appear before a TV judge to sort out the truth.
Nick plans a belated surprise honeymoon for Suzanne, but keeping it a secret causes complications. Elsewhere, Lindsey helps Kevin with his homework.

Arthur always seems to wreck things, and this time it's Mom's computer. Can he get it fixed before Mom finds out? Then, Muffy A. Crosswire and Francine are absolute best friends, despite their rather obvious differences.

What's got moldy bathrooms, lumpy beds and lots of rain? Arthur's family vacation. Then, Arthur and D.W. go to visit their grandfather, but the visit doesn't turn out as expected, because Grandpa Dave isn't your usual kind of grandfather.

A year's supply of Crunch Cereal is in store for the person who can write the new Crunch Cereal jingle, and Arthur is sure he can do it. Next, how hard can it be to do a cartwheel on a balance beam? D.W. is about to find out.

Muffy bets Francine she can't be nice to everyone for a whole week--and soon wishes she hadn't. Next, Arthur didn't mean to tell a lie, he just got stuck in a sort of fib, because he thought it was cool to be a Gleeper.

The circus is in town and the whole family's excited—until Arthur gets CHICKEN POX! Will he recover in time? Then, Arthur's worst fears come true when poor, sick Pal has to sleep overnight at the vet's office. Could it be something he did?

In D.W.’s heart lurks one big, gnawing desire--TO GET RID OF THOSE TRAINING WHEELS! Then, can Coach Frensky work with a baseball team where everyone is fighting about who gets to be pitcher and no one wants to practice?

It's raining and boy is it BORING! But then, in Grandma Thora's attic, Arthur and D.W. discover some really FASCINATING stuff about their parents. Next, Grandma Thora is helping to organize a bake sale, but her goodies aren’t very good.
A new girl has arrived in town and no one knows anything about her. And judging by the strange things happening at her house no one wants to know. Then, it's great having a friend spend the weekend.

D.W. saves everything. But her most prized possession is a snowball from last winter. But now it’s disappeared! Then, Arthur, Francine, and Buster must do a report on ancient Rome--but can they work as a team to complete the assignment?
Is Binky Barnes really the most disgusting, nasty, horrible person on the planet, or is he just misunderstood? Next, what's got four sides and the answer to everything? Prunella's cootie catcher!

It's bad enough to wear glasses all the time. But does Arthur have to be the last person in his class to lose his baby teeth? Then, if you think being lost in a humongous department store would scare a four-year-old, think again.

Once again, Arthur gets to do everything. Mostly he gets to carry the ring in Aunt Lucy's wedding. Elwood City's park is in sad shape, and after grumbling about it, the kids find themselves volunteered to clean it up.

Mr. Ratburn's class is taking a field trips to visit parents at their jobs. Francine's not sure she wants the class to know her dad is a garbage man. And a new carpet and a sneezing attack means Muffy must spend the weekend at Francine's.

D.W. has one little secret--her blankie. When it mysteriously disappears, Arthur is pressed into service. Find that blankie--or else! Next, the unbelievable has happened--Mr. Ratburn has gotten sick. And who's going to be the substitute?

Challenged by Fern to enter a poetry contest, Arthur and his friends each write a poem to be judged by the famous poet Jack Prelutsky. Then, Arthur and his friends develop a consuming passion for the Scare-Your-Pants-Off books.

A massive earthquake destroys Baywatch headquarters and leaves Gina's life hanging in the balance. Meanwhile, Cort and Craig are trapped in the ocean. And Eddie is the only one left who can help a pregnant woman going into labor.
Craig gets jealous when Mitch reunites with his and Craig’s old flame. Meanwhile, Eddie buys a classic Mustang for cheap, only to get arrested for possession of a stolen car.

Jill teams up with Trevor to win a beach volleyball tournament, but all she really wants is to beat her former lover's team. Eddie and Shauni team up to rescue a young girl trapped in an armored car that topples off the pier into the ocean.

Mitch gets a surprise visit from his old, mischievous Navy S.E.A.L. buddy and ex-Baywatch lifeguard, John Cort, adding serious problems in their already complicated relationship. And Shauni and Jill fight a battle of the sexes against a shady vendor.

Craig, Cort, and Eddie take a road trip to Mexico, but their vacation south of the border turns ugly when they tangle with an angry American tourist. Meanwhile, Captian Thorpe becomes Mitch's uninvited house guest. Hobie develops a crush on Shauni.

Cort and Eddie train lifeguards at a water park, but someone is vandalizing the waterslides, putting people's lives in danger. Meanwhile, Captain Thorpe wants Shauni fired for posing in a provocative calendar.
Eddie and Cort happen upon an illegal gambling ship. Meanwhile, Mitch begins to spend more time with Hobie's English teacher – a liaison that embarrasses Hobie beyond belief.

After losing his rookie partner in the mysterious rescue of what he thinks is a ghost, Eddie gets unwittingly caught up in a 70-year-old legend. Meanwhile, Hobie attempts to help a friend find a new home for her dog.

A local restaurateur puts up a $25,000 bounty for the largest shark caught during the weekend's Shark Derby he's sponsoring. To attract more sharks, he illegally chums the waters, drawing hundreds of sharks uncommonly close to shore.

Cort promises to come up with $10,000 for a nursing home, but he needs Mitch and Craig's help to compete in a water-skiing race with a big cash prize. Shauni’s traumatic fear of the ocean after Jill’s death threatens her future with Baywatch.

Craig, Mitch, and Garner go for a weekend hang-gliding trip, but Mitch has a serious accident, and ends up facing death before the fangs of a rattlesnake! Cort reacquaints himself with a woman who has a shocking secret.

Mitch rescues an underwater photographer that appears to have been attacked by a Sea Creature in an underwater cave, resulting in a media frenzy. Shauni rescues a young girl in the ocean then has to rescue her family from drowning.

When a fishing trawler mysteriously sinks, the “Creature in the Bay” is thought responsible! Mitch, Devon and Captain Thorpe set out to prove there is more than meets the eye behind this Creature's mysterious attacks.

After Baywatch lifeguard Megan is attacked on the beach, she struggles to regain her confidence – unaware that her attacker, a fisherman, views her as the One That Got Away. Meanwhile, Shauni suffers from lifeguard burnout.

Four adult siblings say they've been blacklisted by their mother from seeing their dying father, a claim their mother vehemently denies. Emotions run high when this fractured family comes together on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can they put an end to the fighting?

Kristi says daughter Haley has always been a compulsive liar. She says lies Haley has told are that she was a contestant on American Idol, rapper Eminem is her father and she’s diagnosed paranoid schizophrenic. Now she says she's 9 months pregnant. Part 1

Fred And Cynthia say daughter, Crystal, is raising her young son in a death trap! No running water, leaky ceiling, exposed wires, smoking electrical sockets, mice And mold! They are ready for CPS. Crystal says her home is a visible form of how she feels.

Angie says stepfather Ralph routinely sexually abused her as a teen. Angie says that her stepfather didn't stop with her, he turned his attention, affection And sexual abuse toward her daughter Hannah. They say grandma Leta knew, yet looked the other way.

Mark And ex-wife, Melissa, say daughter, Malia, 17, has been running away since age 13, a 6th grade school drop out, And has become physically abusive. They say 2 years ago she became involved with a 35-year-old man And they fear she'll end up dead.

Trust has been ranked as the #1 crucial quality for a happy marriage. Deanne And Brian have been married for 12 years with four children between them. Now, due to alleged lies and infidelity, their family is torn apart and divorce is just a signature away.

When you think of negotiations, corporate boardrooms come to mind but really it happens every day in your own house. Learn the principles of making a deal, how to compromise to get what you want, plus five things you might not realize you can bargain for!
While battling cancer, Paula learned her 21-year-old daughter, C.J., had been turning to drugs, and that her husband had an affair. Can this family come together to save C.J.?

Pregnancy is a time of baby showers, nesting, indulging food cravings and being pampered. But Dr. Phil’s guests, Shayna, says she's been pregnant more than a year, and Zona, says she's been pregnant over 3 1/2 years, Both are looking for answers why.

Rheta says she wants her husband, Mark, to cut the cord with his meddling mother, Deb, who has created an online dating profile for him, paid for divorce lawyers and tried to set him up with his ex-girlfriend! Dr. Phil looks at this troubled union. Part 1

Brittany claims dad Charlie is scammed by his online fiancée Stephanie And her roommate Carina. Charlie has given over $25K while Stephanie maintains a $4.5 million inheritance is coming. The investigation starts in Los Angeles and ends in Denmark!
Do you ever wonder how your favorite Dr. Phil guest is faring since being on the show? Dr. Phil follows up with some of his most talked about guests.

Families are devastated when children go missing, but oftentimes it is a parental abduction. Fifteen years ago, John Clark came home from work to find his wife and three children gone, leaving only a cryptic note saying they went on vacation. Part 1

Horrific allegations are tearing a family apart. Todd, ex girlfriend Latia And mom Diana tell their versions of sexual misconduct. Todd says he will do anything to prove his innocence. Dr. Phil calls in a polygraph examiner, with shocking results.

Dr. Phil welcomes controversial YouTuber Agent Sebastian who runs a page called Cart Narcs posting hundreds of explosive videos apprehending shoppers in parking lots who do not return their carts to the corrals. Is Agent Sebastian breaking the law?

id: Best of The Drew Barrymore Show.us
n: Best of The Drew Barrymore Show.us

p.d: Jessica Simpson chats. Drew tries something new based on viewer requests in new segment “Drew Does…,” first up line dancing. Co-author of “Chef Lenny Cooking for Humans” bearded dragon Chef Lenny And his owner Valerie Musser whip up Ma’s Famous Carrot Cake.

“Bob Hearts Abishola” stars Billy Gardell and Folake Olowofoyeku stop by. Dr. Thanuja Hamilton who shares the biggest causes of not being able to fall asleep and tips to overcome those restless nights. Actress Kat Graham joins Drew’s News.

A Teacher star Kate Mara stops by to chat. Model and actress Molly Sims on the inspiration behind her lifestyle website. TikTok star and culinary contributor Eitan Bernath shares the history behind some of your favorite holiday treats

Drew celebrates the Oscars with Ross Mathews and “Entertainment Tonight's” Kevin Frazier And Nischelle Turner who will be covering Oscars history, fashion, predictions, and more! Oscar nominee “Borat: Subsequent Moviefilm's” Maria Bakalova stops by to chat.

Vanessa Hudgens chats. Drew is joined by Iska Lupton And Anastasia Miari, authors of “Grand Dishes,” a cookbook of recipes from grandmas across the globe. Anastasia’s YiaYia and Jessica Alba join to whip up Mediterranean Roasted Veggies. New Drew's News.

Comedian Nikki Glaser and her mom Julie Glaser stop by to chat. Then, in Retro Cooking, Drew brings the 1950s tuna noodle casserole back to life. Seven-year-old Leo Kelly, aka The Shirley Temple King, stops by to whip up some Shirley Temples with Drew.

Joel McHale stops by to chat. Drew helps entrepreneur Stephanie Davison take her business to the next level. Drew and Ross Mathews are joined by the founder of the disruptive global marketing agency The Social Chain Steven Bartlett in Drew's News.

Today Co-Anchor Hoda Kotb joins Drew to discuss her new book. Drew goes inside one of America’s most Haunted Houses with the help of a medium. Then, Drew gives a curated list of her favorites in The Weekender.

Actress Annaleigh Ashford chats. Drew has a big surprise for nurse Gina Goodwin, who cooks and delivers hundreds of meals every Thanksgiving. Olympic snowboarder Jamie Anderson shares her winter skin routine. Drew reads letters in Dear Drew.

“The United States vs. Billie Holiday” star Andra Day stops by to chat. Design week continues with “Home Town” stars Ben and Erin Napier who help a VFF transform their bookshelf from boring to beautiful. Plus, Ross and Drew with a new Drew’s News.

Ricki Lake shares her personal battle with hair loss over the last 30 years, her year of self-discovery and finding new love. Skincare expert Hyram Yarbo shares his number one skincare tip. Drew and Ross Matthews whip up healthy noodle recipes.

Kevin Bacon joins Drew. Rapper and chef Action Bronson discusses his weight loss and whips up Backyard Markham Street Style Lamb Burgers. Meet the founders of My Fairy Godfathers, a non-profit dedicated to helping women in need by providing makeovers.

Drew kicks-off Beauty Week: Part Deux. Lena Dunham joins Drew. Michele Obama’s stylist Meredith Koop gives a makeover for a mom in need of a date night refresh. Makeup artist and founder of Uoma Beauty Sharon Chuter co-pilots a beauty-themed Drew’s News.

Drew sits down for an exclusive conversation with Dylan Farrow on her HBO Max docuseries “Allen vs. Farrow.” Katherine Schwarzenegger Pratt chats. Chef Pilar Valdes and founder of Nguyen Coffee Supply Sahra Nguyen share ways to use coffee in the kitchen.

Holidate star Emma Roberts stops by. Sesame Street’s Big Bird helps Drew celebrate World Kindness Day and Drew wraps up craft week with Danny Seo. Plus, Drew sends viewers into the weekend with a curated list of her favorite picks in The Weekender.

El Coqui: In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.

Stuck Truck: Calling all trucks! Boots sure loves trucks. When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue. Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.
Louder!: What are we going to do? Cockledoodledoo! Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun. Along the way we practice making lots of noise.
Roberto The Robot: Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

The Big Potato: Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

Journey To The Purple Planet: Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

The Lost City: Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.
Meet Diego!: Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

Save The Puppies: Woof! Woof! Dora and Boots have a new video game called Save the Puppies. A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages. To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

¡Por Favor!: Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou - a cute and cuddly forest creature - who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, por favor.

Baby Dino: Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island. It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs. Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.
Boots' Special Day: Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots most favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

To The South Pole: Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin! It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Pingüino all the way back home to the South Pole.

Dora Saves The Game: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!
What Happens Next?: What comes after The End? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.
In Louisiana, a brutal killer turned a rural area into his personal hunting ground. He preyed on the defenseless, the weak and the elderly.

In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

Etna, New Hampshire is a small town. It's the kind of place where people trust their neighbors and leave their doors unlocked. A double murder shattered that trust and left the entire community terrified.

A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.

Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.
In 1980 the FBI faced the largest explosive device they had ever seen. The bomb was sophisticated, carefully constructed, and designed to destroy an entire building.

In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. Their MO was familiar. The gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence.

Caught in the act, a disguised bank robber hurled explosives at police and disappeared in a hail of bullets. When police identified the suspect, they connected him to an armed kidnapping, but they couldn't find him.

Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

Doctors are puzzled when a two-year-old boy is rushed to the hospital with brain seizures and breathing difficulties. Finally, the boy's sister provides an important clue, raising the possibility of a rare syndrome.
In 2003, Kathy Lorick was murdered on a Concord, California jogging trail while talking to her husband on her mobile phone.
In a 1992 murder case, the autopsy of a cremated body turns up telltale clues of foul play.

In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John Jack Denofa to his motel room.
The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith goes missing after an argument with her husband, Bill Bruns. When investigators find a blood trail that leads to the couple's basement, police are sure they'll find the victim's body.
Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

Edward Post drew a bath for his wife before going for a run. He returned to find her not breathing. She died before emergency response arrived. Police considered her death accidental until a motive surfaced.

An investigation into the murder of a World War II veteran slowed to a halt when the prime suspect had a solid alibi. But a lucky break led to a shady character who wore distinctive boots and had a sweet tooth.
When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. But the body had been placed in the barrel 30 years earlier. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.
In 2000, teenager Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant. Did she run away, or was she the victim of foul play?
Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé, Keyon Pittman. When police learned that Pittman was having affairs with other women, he became the prime suspect.
Frasier is jealous of Niles' fame resulting from Maris' murder case.
Martin gets high on a pot-laced brownie; Frederick visits the dark side.
A KACL team competes in a weight-loss marathon with another radio station for a trip to Las Vegas. Niles and Martin nurse an ailing pigeon back to health.
Ann Hodges grudgingly agrees to assess Frasier's apartment for a home insurance quote; but when she falls and breaks her leg, Frasier is afraid she will sue.
The Cranes are plagued by bizarre nightmares on a trip to the mountains.
Frasier's libido fights a losing battle with his conscience when his (married) ex-wife, children's entertainer Nanny G, comes to town and invites him backstage for a rendezvous.
Frasier accidentally gives Martin a mild heart attack by scaring him dressed as a clown, holding a knife.
Desperate to add some excitement to his life, Frasier does something completely out of character.
Daphne and Niles prepare for their baby's arrival, and Frasier looks for love.
Frasier is taken with Charlotte, but she already has a boyfriend, a handsome man named Frank. To try and get his mind off her, Roz takes him to a singles bar.
Frasier plans elaborate dates to try to win Charlotte away from her boyfriend, but ends up being a third wheel when Frank continually shows up, who is oblivious of his intentions.
A road trip takes Frasier and Charlotte off the beaten path, and a series of misunderstandings turns three job interviews into a comedy of errors.
A terra cotta cheese crock becomes a time capsule for Frasier.
Both personally and professionally, Frasier's life is about to change forever.
Frasier, Niles, Daphne, Martin, and Roz move on to new chapters in their lives.
A Klansman comes of age in the Deep South and eventually joins the civil rights movement.

Ben (Ben Banks), a 28-year-old journalism student, is a master of avoiding responsibility. His ambition is finally awakened when he meets a gorgeous woman (Mischa Barton) and is drawn into a conspiracy.
Convinced that his newfound friend (Ryan Reynolds) is a good-luck charm, a gambling addict (Ben Mendelsohn) takes the man on a road trip to a high-stakes poker game in New Orleans.

Gary Tison, imprisoned for murder, makes one last dash for freedom with the help of his trusting and loyal family. Commanding his three sons, Tison and his gang leave a trail of bodies in their wake as they do all they can to reach the border.
A lovestruck teenager will do anything to win the gal of his dreams, including making a bet with a mobster's son.
An inmate uses whatever means necessary to convince a parole officer (Robert De Niro) to grant his release.

After his girlfriend is kidnapped while on vacation, an American man is forced to smuggle cocaine over the border. If he's ever to see her alive again, he'll have to navigate a treacherous underworld of violence and greed.

When their attempt to rob a gangster's (Robert De Niro) casino goes awry, a desperate man (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and his partner (Dave Bautista) hijack a city bus to escape from the police and a maniacal thug (Morris Chestnut).
A fallen swordsman (Clive Owen) leads a small army against a sadistic ruler to avenge his dishonored master (Morgan Freeman).

This season opens with twenty aspiring chefs presenting signature dishes in Las Vegas, where they split into two teams and attempt to impress Chef Ramsay.
In the second part of the season opener, the twenty contestants settle into their dorms and prepare their first dinner service, which goes poorly with incomplete and undercooked dishes being served.
The remaining contestants participate in a physical challenge. Each team has five minutes to climb a wall and retrieve as many lobsters as possible.
The two teams must create a healthy meal for Olympians Maurice Greene, Natalie Coughlin and Danell Leyva after a 3,000m run. The winners jet off to California's Temecula Valley Wine Country.
Chef Ramsay orders the remaining contestants to identify the particular protein used in five meat dishes. The fastest team to guess all five proteins wins a day at the beach in Malibu.
Dinner service comes to a halt when Jean-Philippe requests help in the dining room. When one contestant from each team helps the wait staff, Ramsay discovers that both draw illegible checks.
Chef Ramsay challenges the remaining contestants to create six stunning Chinese dishes, which will then be judged by the renowned chef Martin Yan.
For the team challenge, the remaining contestants visit an animal pen to choose a form of protein to cook with. During the dinner service, the budding chefs must impress Chef Ramsay's family as well.
The aspiring chefs must cut a steak, cook it to medium-rare and then serve it with a spice rub or sauce of their own making. The winners spend the afternoon lounging around a pool.
Hosting its first quinceañera, Hell's Kitchen throws a party fit for a princess. Each team must make a five course tasting menu based on the guest of honor's preferences.
Representatives from both teams have thirty seconds to gather as many slips of paper as they can while in a wind chamber. The teams must cook five dishes based on the ingredients listed on the slips.
Chef Ramsay asks the teams to create their own menus for a dinner service that features Ian Ziering (Beverly Hills, 90210) and Nikki SooHoo (The Lovely Bones) as special guests.
The teams must create an ethnic dish in 45 minutes including a protein of their choice. The winners go on a shopping spree at a boutique and receive a set of copper-clad cookware.
The remaining chefs participate in a challenge that tests their skills at identifying foods merely by touch. The winners eat seafood at Malibu's Nobu restaurant.
Chef Ramsay rewards the chef who has made the greatest stride in the competition with immunity from elimination during the next dinner service, in which the contestants try to impress the judges.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

Lucy goes on a hunger strike in order to get Ricky to buy an expensive dress from a famous French designer. He finally gives in but returns the dress when he discovers that Ethel smuggled her food while on the strike.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are on a train for Rome when Lucy is 'discovered' by an Italian film director who offers her a role in his new picture, Bitter Grapes.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are leaving Genoa for Nice when Lucy decides they should all go by bicycle because they can't see enough of the countries from the train. Ricky and the Mertzes agree under protest and after an exhausting day of pedaling.

Ricky is working in Monte Carlo, but Fred goofed and bargained for too little money for the engagement. Lucy and Ethel go to the casino to watch, but when Lucy finds a chip that someone dropped and replaces it on the table, it wins and continues to do so.
The Ricardos and Mertzes need to return to the United States by plane instead of ship creating problems for Lucy who has bought, among other souvenirs, a 30-pound cheese.

Ricky is opening a new night spot, the Club Babalu, and wants Bob Hope to appear at the grand opening. Lucy fears Hope won't because of her widespread reputation for causing chaos, and wants to reassure him that this time she's butting out.

Although they both agree not to try and influence Little Ricky's future, Lucy buys a toy doctor kit and Ricky gives him a drum set. Their son takes to the drums and begins to play it non-stop for days.
Orson Welles is scheduled to perform for a benefit in Ricky's club. Ricky is worried that Lucy will foul things up if she is around so he decides to send her off to Florida.

Little Ricky is scheduled to play the drums in his first music school recital. Although his parents and the Mertzes are overcome with nervousness, Little Ricky seems calm until his big moment arrives, then goes to pieces.
Mario, the Ricardos' and Mertzes' gondolier in Venice, comes to New York to surprise his brother, but turns up at the Ricardos' apartment when he can't find him.
After a recent fire and years of neglect, sisters Jessica, Sabrina and Sue need Scott’s help turning a giant problem into profit.
Inside and out, Nadia’s cabin in the woods looks more like the type of dull, dated suburban home renters are trying to escape for a week. Scott injects the property with a fun canoe theme design.

With rolling sand dunes, powdery sand and epic sunsets just outside the door, Eva and Stewart should have no problem renting their beachside property. Problem is, no one has renovated the place since the 1970’s.
Elena and Kelly’s property resembles a giant beige box with almost nothing that attracts renters both inside and out.
Vicky and Todd recently bought a dated old house near a ski hill, and they think it could earn them some money, if the proper reno job were done.
Sabrina and her daughter Tess just purchased a large but neglected boathouse on the scenic Lake of Bays. Scott sees the potential to turn this into a truly unique vacation property.
Rowan and his son Curtis just bought a 3 bedroom lake house to enjoy and rent out for part of the year. But the property is looking bland and boring.
Marc, a fire captain in the city, bought a farmhouse to create some family memories with his son, and daughter Megan. However, it’s pretty clear this rundown place was built purely for function.
Homeowners Reesha and Duncan purchased a rundown lakeside cabin to rent out and generate income for their growing family.

Built in the early 1970s, Anita’s dad’s Muskoka cottage has strong bones but is very outdated. She wants to turn it into a place that will both honor his legacy and generate an income so the family can hold onto the property.
After going more than half a century without renovations, Julia and John are hoping their worn-out family cabin - built by John’s grandfather - can start generating money for them.
Empty nesters Darlene and James have a family cottage located on the beautiful Moon River that’s in bad need of repair.

Fitness instructors Cindy and Sean own a historic 150-year-old cabin in Muskoka. They’re hoping to rent it out to fund their travel plans, but first they want the years of haphazard add-ons remodeled.
Erin and Gerald are the owners of a rundown cottage they don’t use so much anymore. They’re hoping that a good renovation will turn it into a profit generator.
Nadia and Anwar bought their farmhouse on a semi-whim as a generational property to enjoy with their daughters, but also with the intention of generating some short-term rental income.
Working solo to test their precision, the artists must create mural designs using only staples, then tattoo portraits of senior citizens.
The artists create one-of-a-kind designs on protective headgear in the Flash Challenge, and composition is key for a daunting elimination tattoo featuring Japanese cranes.
Five artists must tattoo a subject and style chosen by their competitors in an elimination challenge, followed by a 13-hour tattooing marathon to send a second artist home.
With a chance to win $100,000 and the title of Ink Master, 10 of the world's best tattoo artists put their skills to the test.
Heather challenges the judges' critiques, a head tattoo becomes a medical emergency, and Ton Jones joins the panel as a guest judge.
The artists test their shading skills on naked female canvases during the Flash Challenge, Al rubs the other artists the wrong way, and one more artist is sent home.
The artists test their technical precision skills, a photo realism tattoo turns disastrous for one artist, and Inked Magazine's Todd Weinberger serves as a guest judge.
The artists test their color skills designing pieces for canvases with prosthetic limbs, and acclaimed tattoo artist Scott Campbell joins the panel as a guest judge.
A surprise Flash Challenge tattoo sparks panic in the shop, the artists struggle through a pinup Elimination Tattoo, and NBA star Chris Birdman Andersen is the guest judge.
Lettering skills are put to the test during a graffiti flash challenge, and the portrait elimination tattoo leaves the four remaining artists with no room for error.
The final artists are given a 12-hour master canvas challenge playing to their favorite styles, and an Ink Master is chosen.
The artists head to the morgue to face off in their first Flash Challenge, and tattoo virgins experience their first tastes of ink during the Elimination Tattoo.
The artists test their ingenuity by camouflaging models, a medical emergency threatens the future of one competitor, and NFL star Terrell Suggs joins as a guest judge.
The artists test their line skills in the barbershop, military veterans sit in for an American classic style Elimination Tattoo, and tattoo legend Richard Stell guest judges.
The artists face off in a three-round Flash Challenge, a canvas asks for a tattoo with a unique placement, and NBA star Matt Barnes joins as a guest judge.
Morimoto fights a traditionalist chef who fills his dishes with nostalgia.
Meiji Kinenkan is the oldest bridal hall in Japan undergoing an upgrade to celebrate its 50th anniversary. This includes the addition of a Chinese restaurant and its new grand chef.
Iron Chef Chen stirs up his best yogurt presentation against Challenger Junichi Ito.
Iron Chef Morimoto battles with Challenger Tsuyoshi Kajimoto as they innovate with abalone, a shellfish.
The Iron Chef is called upon to face Miyoko Sakai, a famed Thai food critic who has had the privilege to learn the secrets of royal Thai cuisine straight from the source.
Iron Chef Morimoto faces another traditionalist who is infamous for his temper, his steadfast discipline and his adherence to tradition.
The challenger in this battle of peach is Masanobu Watabe, owner of Le Rameau d'Or in Yokohama, Japan. Watabe runs the entire 22-seat restaurant by himself.
Chen's challenger is a man who masters Chaozhou-style Chinese cuisine, an exacting style that is actually able to please the sensitive tastes of customers in Kyoto.
Sakai battles the 'conjurer of garlic,' a chef who embraces the pungent ingredient as real Italians do. Sakai is further challenged to use live squids in the dishes.
Three years after losing to Iron Chef Chen, the Italian restaurant Sabatini demands a rematch, this time sending in the master chef of their Tokyo restaurant.
Led by Tadamichi Ohta, the chef who defeated Sakai, the Ohta faction invades Kitchen Stadium to uphold traditional Japanese cuisine. Fuji is team Ohta's first contender against Morimoto.
In honor of the Girls' Festival, Kaga invites a challenger from the ancient city of Kamakura, Motohito Kondo, who was trained in Kyoto and is an expert in both tea and sake.
Tasaki is a world champion sommelier who has always dreamed of becoming a famed chef. Chairman Kaga decides to grant him his wish.
The American chef Ron Seigel challenges Iron Chef Sakai in this battle of lobster. Who will emerge victorious?
The first female challenger at Kitchen Stadium, the 26-year-old Kagata defeated Chef Chen. Years later, she returns to fight Chen again with milk-fed veal.

Two Marines in a Humvee mistakenly drive into Iraq; an Iraqi detail intercepts them, kills one, and captures the other.
A woman Marine recruit dies at Parris Island. Harm investigates while Meg poses undercover as a recruit.

Doug buys a motorcycle against Carrie's wishes, prompting her to take up cigarette smoking to spite him.
Doug encourages Carrie to make new friends but then he feels left out when she starts spending a lot of time with their new neighbor.
After Doug convinces Carrie he doesn't goof around at work, horseplay gets him into a painful and embarrassing predicament.

Doug gets upset with Carrie after his big-screen TV set is stolen because she accidentally left the garage door open.
Doug feels so guilty about putting down Arthur that he gives him one of his Mets tickets; Doug gets arrested trying to catch a foul ball.
Doug and Carrie feel inadequate when they discover that their best friends have a very active love life.
Doug and Carrie invite Ray and Debra Barone to dinner; Doug gets stuck in an opening leading up to the attic.
Doug gets an ego boost when an attractive waitress wants to know if he's single.
Doug invites Spence to move in as part of a plan to keep Carrie's annoying friends from spending a weekend.
Doug's bowling-team sponsor demands victory, meaning Doug may have to fire his team's weak link: his wife, Carrie.
Carrie insists on using Doug's Christmas bonus to invest in Internet stock.
Carrie helps Doug plan a bachelor party after she volunteers him to be the friendless Danny's best man.
Doug's memories of his glory days as a football player don't match those of his old teammates.
Arthur disrupts Carrie and Doug's lives by moving from the cold basement to the much warmer second floor.

Three chefs enter the arena blazing and ready for battle in the Wildfire Round. In the Crossfire Round, it’s steak versus pork in the battle of the comfort classics. In the Feast of Fire, the judges are served classic steakhouse feasts.

Three chefs think they have what it takes to be a Fire Masters champion. In the Crossfire Round, it’s a battle of the turkey breast and in the Feast of Fire the chefs step right up for some carnival feasts.

Three chefs think they have what it takes to be a Fire Masters Champion. In the Crossfire Round, the chefs hit the grills for the battle of the wild. In the Feast of Fire, the chefs serve up BBQ feasts grilled to perfection.
Three chefs enter the arena ready to grill in the Wildfire Round. It’s a fierce battle of the kebab in the Crossfire Round and in the Feast of Fire, pub grub is on the menu.
Three chefs are ready to burn the competition in the Wildfire Round. In the Crossfire Round, it’s battle Tuna Loin and in the Feast of Fire, the chefs serve up a beef lovers’ banquet.

Ten home bakers enter the kitchen and put their spin on a chocolate carousel filled with decadent mini desserts. In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers give a sweet introduction to who they are with a dessert inspired by the Cabinet of Curiosities.
The remaining nine home bakers will play with pastry, as they master the art of choux. In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers must keep their cool and serve an epic ice cream sandwich.

Eight bakers vie for Golden Whisk immunity and seek to make the judges’ sweet dreams come true as they delve into the delightful world of candy. In the Elimination Challenge, the home bakers must prove that chocolate and vegetables can go together.

Sweet safety is on the line for the seven remaining home bakers. Things get saucy in the Technique Test, as the bakers use their noodles to create a delicious, chocolate pasta. In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers take a sweet trip down memory lane.

With sweet safety off the table, the top six bakers must create a scrumptious illusion by mastering a gravity-defying cake. In the Elimination Challenge, the home bakers create desserts using a flavour of tea.

In the Technique Test, the five remaining home bakers do the chocolate truffle shuffle and create a picture-perfect display made entirely out of chocolate. In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers must present a dessert bursting with floral flavour.

The final four bakers are in for a big surprise as they must master the daunting macaron and its larger cousin the macaronade! Fashion becomes their passion as the bakers look to the runway for their dessert inspiration.

In this epic season finale, the home bakers take on the most demanding bake of the entire competition. Only one baker will have the happy ending of walking away with the $50,000 grand prize and the title of Great Chocolate Showdown Champion.
Each celebrity will be vying to win a big cash prize for their favourite charity. Hold on to your pots, this is going to be a wild ride!

Three chefs hit the grills running in the Signature dish round, serving up some meaty mains. In the Crossfire round, the chefs really need to beef up their game. The Feast of Fire round is inspired by la dolce vita!

Bryan struggles to get the house's concrete footings into the ground.

After the house is framed, the mechanicals of the home are ready to be installed but a recent change in the plumbing code throws a wrench in plans to forge ahead.
A feisty female has it out for Bryan and this time it is not his wife Sarah. Mother Nature has dropped some ill-timed storms and heavy rain that causes a wave of delays.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: After $40,000 is stolen from Wells Fargo's safe, a drunk Doc Holliday rides into Tombstone with $4000 in stolen bonds. Since he was named as one of the robbers, Earp is forced to arrest him.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Army mule and horse remounts are stolen from a Tombstone stable. The owner was severely injured and didn't see the robbers but Roscoe did and was kicked by a stolen mule.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: The San Berdoo gang is hitting Arizona on their way to Mexico. Earp dislikes posses but the size of the gang mandates one.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: A young man arrives in Tombstone looking for Evangeline Murphy. But a look at her picture tells John Clum she is really Evie Marlowe, a saloon singer.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: A robbery starts a series of events that lead Johnny Ringo to kidnap Judge Spicer to release his cousin Charlie Parks from jail.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: After Wells Fargo is robbed and an agent killed, Thacker pressures Earp to capture the killers.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: The heat on the Ten Percent Ring has reached Washington, who is considering a new territorial governor.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Wyatt Earp heads south to make peace when he learns that Old Man Clanton has sent his men into Mexico to rob the silver trains and steal the cattle of wealthy Mexican rancher Don Sebastian.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: During a robbery, Doc Goodfellow is shot accidentally by the Hewitt gang. But Doc Holliday says a real surgeon is needed to remove the bullet.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Doc Holliday has a shadow named Johnny O'Rourke who is always at Doc's beck and call. He decides Doc's life is the one he wants which includes ignoring his fiancé Marcia.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Due to the trouble in Arizona, the new governor has decided on a shoot-to-kill order and uses vigilantes to stop the lawlessness.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Old Man Clanton threatens Behan with replacement unless he stops Earp from rousting his men in Tombstone.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Morgan Earp has been helping Wyatt for a month but Morgan's interest in drinking, women, and hanging with Doc Holliday bothers Wyatt.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Ned Buntline returns to Tombstone to interview widow Amy Jones. She is after money to get out of Tombstone so when Buntline has no money she tries other means, including framing Earp.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Odie Cairns learns that a couple who are True Lighters are moving into the Tombstone area. Odie takes it upon himself to drive the couple out of town which Earp must stop.
Al tries to ditch Peggy on her birthday until she catches him in the act and tags along with the family.
Peggy tries to earn her G.E.D. with Kelly in night school.
Kelly chooses to be a weather girl rather than go to school which makes the Bundy's happy since she'll be making more money than Al.

After being plagued by nightmares of feet a beautiful woman asks Al to judge a contest at Gary's, whose contestants she, could never compete with. Meanwhile, Kelly tricks Marcy and Bud into thinking they've slept together.

Peggy will buy anything at a yard sale, so when she brings home a boar's head, there's no more room in the garage to put it. So, Al decides enough is enough and he decides to have his own yard sale, despite Peggy's protests.
The Bundys decide to go for a drive--on Labor Day. They spend the better part of the holiday sitting in traffic, arguing with one another, and picking fights with neighboring motorists.
Al and Kelly feign illness to avoid going to Wanker County with Peg and Bud. Al looks forward to his quiet and peaceful weekend until Kelly gets sick.

Bud's new driver's license portends bumper cars on the roadway. When bud t-bones a Mercedes, Al sees an opportunity to clean up in court. At least he has hope. Losing his lawsuit hurt but what he goes through to pay off the settlement is truly painful.
Al is cut from the neighborhood softball team just before the big game. When his all-star replacement is knocked out in the last inning, however, his team and family have to come crawling back.
Peggy goes out dancing with Marcy and becomes taken with a handsome man-about-town named Andy. At home, however, Al gets confronted by Andy's wife, Pete.
Now an aspiring model, Kelly invents a maneuver called The Bundy Bounce for her first audition as spokesperson for the new Allente car.
After Al returns home from work with a bump on the head, he sees (or thinks he sees) six little green aliens coming down to Earth and stealing his smelly socks to use as fuel for their spaceships.
Al decides to grow a vegetable garden but soon faces off against an all-out war with a rabbit who steals his carrots and other vegetables.
When Al moves a sofa off a neighbor's lawn without a shirt on, he unexpectedly gains a reputation as a stud among the neighborhood women.
Tired of Al escorting her dates out through the doorway, grown-up Kelly gets her own apartment.

With its conductors sound asleep, a freight train fails to stop and collides with an oncoming train, resulting in tragedy.
Experts face a tricky investigation into the crash of TANS Peru Flight 204 after key evidence is looted from the crash site.
A helicopter carrying offshore oil workers crashes into the ocean off the coast of Newfoundland and a far-reaching investigation reveals a fatal flaw.
United Airlines Flight 718 and Trans World Airlines Flight 2 collide midair over the Grand Canyon in Arizona, killing all 128 people on both aircraft in 1956.

p.t: Mayday: Air Disaster The Accident Files
p.d: A FedEx flight out of Memphis descended into chaos when a surprise attack by a disgruntled employee threatened the lives of all on board.
A bomb explodes on Air India Flight 182 en route from Canada to India causing it to disintegrate over the coast of Ireland.
When Alaska Airlines Flight 261 suddenly nosedives into the Pacific, investigators uncover a critical maintenance issue with deadly implications.
Korean Air Cargo Flight 8509 crashes shortly after take off from London Stansted Airport on December 22, 1999.
Someone is killing off bell ringers of the parish church in the week before a big bell-ringing competition takes place in the village of Midsomer Wellow.
Barnaby investigates the murder of a boy during a traditional annual race at an exclusive private school but is met with resentment.
An investigation of a car fire and a bludgeoning murder lead Barnaby and Troy to investigate the members of a local reading club which has an agenda that goes beyond books.
A woman is found dead in Setwale Wood, an apparent suicide, except that her suicide note is emailed after her body has already been sighted.
Barnaby and his new partner, D.S. Nelson (Gwilym Lee, Jamestown), investigate the fatal stabbing of a man with an antique sword during a ghost-hunting party at a manor house.
A series of murders in Midsomer St Claire seems to be inspired by macabre images on a medieval fresco recently discovered in the church crypt.
When the landlord of Wyvern House meets a brutal and untimely death in his own woods, many aspersions are cast.
The owner of Finchmere airfield is dropped from a plane to meet a gruesome death. Are anti-craft campaigners behind his murder? Or does it link back to a WWII mission?
Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish police detectives after a Midsomer businessman is poisoned during a trip to Copenhagen.

Bones found on a farm in Missouri lead to a deadly cattle scheme. As police dig deeper, they uncover a grisly trail of human remains and a murderous plot.
In 1984, a brutal couple wreaks havoc across the Midwest with a spree of robbery, rape, and murder. Police race to stop them before more lives are claimed.
In 1980, LA police hunt a serial killer targeting runaways. The discovery of a decapitated man’s body raises fears of a copycat or an even more dangerous accomplice.

When Genora Guillory is murdered in her home, investigators find several suspects on the Louisiana woman’s final 24-hour timeline. Unable to pin anyone down, the case goes cold… until a witness comes forward with the inside story of ‘the perfect murder.’

When firefighters extinguish the flames of an apartment fire, they discover the charred remains of Missy Grubaugh. Several of her coworkers soon come under scrutiny, and Detectives must use the timeline to determine which one of them is the killer.

When a nursing student is shot dead outside a Houston community college, the search is on for a brazen shooter in a red car. Detectives retrace the last 24 hours of the victim’s life, and unearth a number of potential suspects.

The body of a 16-year-old high school cheerleader is found floating in a river bordering Texas and Oklahoma. The police investigation unearths several promising suspects, before an unexpected break points to a killer already in their midst.

Popular newlyweds Rick and Gail Brink are shot execution-style in their Michigan home. But it will take 25 years before investigators uncover a flaw in the timeline that convinces them of the killer’s guilt.

A man comes home to find his fiancée dead in the bedroom of their home. The discovery of infidelity puts the man in the hot seat. As investigators piece together the victim’s final 24 hours, they uncover a plot more shocking than they could have imagined.

In rural Michigan, 34-year-old Deborah Boothby is run over on the highway, and for nine years the case goes unsolved. That is, until a team of detectives review the evidence and the hit-and-run cold case becomes a murder investigation.
The story of crusading attorney Juliet Yackel and her desperate attempt to save her client, Darnell Williams, whose execution for the double murder of an elderly couple is only one month away.
A look at the case of Farah Frattah, a Texas woman who was murdered after claiming that her husband, Bob, was a sexual deviant and a threat to their children's safety.
A look at the strange case of Carrie Culberson, a former cheerleader who vanished in 1996 from Blanchester, Ohio. Her boyfriend, Vincent Doan, was convicted of murdering her.

A look at the case of Marty Tankleff, who gave police a partial confession to the murder of his parents, recanted it, but was convicted anyway. Tankleff's attorneys say they've found new evidence that could exonerate him.
Tom Cummins and his two cousins Julie and Robin Kerry were out for a night of fun. By morning, the two girls had been raped and pushed to their deaths from the Chain of Rocks bridge in St. Louis.
Immigrant Rafe Pegarski gives his teacher a family heirloom, a gold pocket watch, in return for schooling.
A man who claims he can resurrect the dead poses a problem for killer Bill Groat.
A reporter probes reports that a general is selling guns to Natives in exchange for their property.
In Totem, Idaho, Dorsey Bilger has told one tall tale too many.

With two small children and a strong family focus, Lauren and Jeremy are looking for a kid-friendly forever home in an established neighbourhood miles from the Strip.
After tying the knot, newlyweds Kristen and Ben moved in with her parents. And though they’re eager to find a home of their own, their house hunt has been more frustrating than expected.

Cartman découvre un Jakovasaure femelle, puis un mâle.

p.t: South Park: Le Panda du Harcèlement Sexuel
p.d: Un panda, venu dans la classe de Stan et de ses amis expliquer le principe du harcèlement sexuel et encourager sa dénonciation, déclenche une folie du procès à South Park.
Mme Cartman va à la fête donnée chez M. Mackey et laisse son fils sous la garde de Shelly Marsh.

p.t: South Park: Deux Hommes tout Nus dans un Jacuzzi
p.d: Après avoir laissé Shelley chez les Cartman, la famille Marsh se rend chez M. Mackey, et Stan est relégué à la cave avec d'autres enfants pas très fréquentables. Pendant ce temps, les papas de South Park expérimentent le jacuzzi.
Pendant que leurs parents sont à la fêtes, Kyle, Ike et Kenny sont à une fête religieuse juif. Ils se rendent compte rapidement que cette cérémonie sera propice à un complot.
Les enfants sont pris dans la folie Chinpokomon qui est en fait une conspiration anti-americaine de nostalgiques de Pearl Harbor.
Pascal la Dalle cherche où reloger son village pour qu'ils échappent aux missionnaires chrétiens.

p.t: South Park: Korn et le Mystère Mystérieux
p.d: À l'approche d'Halloween, South Park est en effervescence, sauf le père Maxi qui considère cette fête comme une vénération de Satan.

p.t: South Park: Les Comptines du Singe Batteur
p.d: Un concours d'orthographe a lieu à South Park. Deux enfants qui sont scolarisés à domicile remportent le trophée alors que Cartman avait une arme secrète : les comptines du singe batteur.

p.t: South Park: Médaille de Connerie avec Palme
p.d: Une reconstitution de la bataille de la guerre de Sécession, opposant les Nordistes aux Sudistes, est organisée à South Park.

p.t: South Park: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey
p.d: Mr Hankey nous présente ses meilleurs vœux sous forme de showcase musical où tout le monde participe.

p.t: South Park: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil
p.d: Le monde se prépare à passer à l'an 2000, à South Park, on s'attend à ce que Jésus fasse venir Dieu sur Terre pour le millénium.
Un énorme concert de flûtes à bec dirigé par Yoko Ono et réunissant les enfants de tous les États-Unis doit se dérouler dans l'Arkansas.
Cartman is sure he's dead and Butters is sure that Eric Cartman's ghost is haunting him. Together they attempt to make amends to all the people Cartman has wronged over the years.
The South Park Elementary School Talent Show is coming up and Jimmy can't wait to perform his comedy routine, but first, he must find a way to gain control of his raging hormones.
Butters must fake his death, dress up as a girl and infiltrate a slumber party, in order to retrieve a future-telling device Cartman is convinced the girls have.
In an effort to thwart her ex-lovers plans to get married, Mrs. Garrison leads the charge against gay marriage.
After the sudden on-set of the disease Gingervitis, Cartman rallies all other ginger kids to rise up and assume their role as the master race.

Scientologists converge on Stan's house after he is identified as the reincarnation of L. Ron Hubbard. One A-lister locks himself in the closet and refuses to come out after Stan criticizes his 'talent.'

The boys try to rescue their new friend Willzyx, a talking space whale, from the Denver Sea Park, and with the help of MASA (Mexican Aeronautica y Spacia Administracion) get him home to the moon for $200.
Stan is embarrassed when his dad gets pulled over for drunk driving. Randy believes that only one thing can save him from his 'disease,' a bleeding statue of the Virgin Mary in the next town.
Chef returns to South Park after spending time away with a group called, 'The Super Adventure Club,' but when his strange behavior starts getting him in trouble, the boys risk everything to save him.
Kyle and his family are moving to San Francisco. The only way Stan can get his best friend back is to convince everyone to start driving hybrid cars.
Towelie gets over his drug addiction and writes his memoirs. With Oprah's support, his book becomes a best seller and his story inspires millions to turn their lives around.
Al Gore warns the school about the threat of Manbearpig.
When Cartman's mom realizes she can't control her son anymore, she gets help from an expert. The Dog Whisperer may have what it takes but Eric Cartman's not going down without a fight.
The boys dedicate their lives to defeating a mad gamer and saving the World of Warcraft.
The world's biggest conspiracy of all time is finally uncovered when Eric Cartman exposes the true culprit behind the September 11th attacks.

Cartman discovers the joys of having Tourette’s syndrome. Drunk with the power of saying whatever he wants without getting in trouble for it, he lines up national TV coverage to take advantage of his new life with no filters.

Cartman finds himself fighting for his life after a routine tonsillectomy goes wrong. When Kyle becomes infected with Cartman's ailment, the two won't stop for anything as they search for a cure that will reverse their otherwise certain mortality.
The Coon rises from the trash and takes his place as a lone vigilante who wipes out crime in the town of South Park.
Cartman's dream of living the life of a pirate will come true if he can just get to Somalia.
Cartman is chosen to do the morning announcements at South Park Elementary.

Cartman’s favorite restaurant has been shut down and replaced by a store that sells medicinal marijuana. Randy is desperate to get a prescription card to buy pot and Cartman will do anything to get his beloved fried chicken back.
Cartman dreams of being a NASCAR driver and he’s willing to do whatever it takes to make it happen.
Cartman throws a fit when the boys' penis sizes are posted on the school bulletin board, and is sent to anger management therapy.
The 99% is ganging up on Eric Cartman.
The time has finally come for Cartman to let a special someone know exactly how he feels.
Cartman finally admits he's fat and immediately gets a mobility scooter.
Cartman infiltrates the NSA and doesn’t like what he finds in his personal file.
Cartman sees Token as a threat to all humanity.
Randy is harboring a giant secret and the pressure is getting to him. Meanwhile, Cartman calls Stan a cissy.
Cartman considers himself the top on-line restaurant reviewer in South Park.
When Ike hits puberty, he and Kyle start to grow apart. To save their relationship, Kyle takes Ike to see a live performance of Yo Gabba Gabba.
Kyle just wants to play video games with his little brother. But, when Ike doesn’t want to play with him anymore, Kyle is afraid that the next generation is passing him by.
Cartmaan Bra is trending as the country prepares to watch the biggest Holiday Spectacular ever.
Cartman considers himself the top on-line restaurant reviewer in South Park.
Kyle's mom won't let him keep his new pet, an elephant because it's so huge. So the boys turn turn to the Dr. Mephesto to genetically engineer a smaller elephant.
While South Park Elementary is attempting to stage a non-denominational holiday play that won't offend (or entertain) anyone, Kyle checks himself into the South Park mental asylum.
The boys' discovery of a prehistoric relic spawns a monster that threatens to destroy South Park and the world.
Mr. Mackey, the school counselor, is fired and turns to drugs and alcohol. Meanwhile, when the boys find out what it means to be circumcised they try to save Ike from his Bris.
Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny are caught up in the latest fad from Japan: Chinpoko Mon!
When Cartman discovers the Tooth Fairy is paying a premium price for his lost teeth, he and the boys seize the opportunity to make some cash.
Kyle needs a kidney transplant and Cartman is discovered to be the perfect donor. Cartman gladly offers his kidney to Kyle -- for the price of $10 million dollars.
To get back at his parents for not letting him go to a concert, Kyle tells the police that his parents molested him. Soon, the whole town is free of adults and divided into two rival cities.
Mr. Garrison gets fed up with long lines, delayed flights and the airline industry in general and invents his own transportation device.
Cartman convinces the boys to toilet paper their teacher's house, but Kyle is overwhelmed with guilt.
Kyle chooses Stan, Kenny, and Butters to celebrate his birthday at Casa Bonita. When Cartman finds out he's not invited, he arranges for Butters to conveniently go missing.
Cartman launches his own gem shopping channel.
Butters is the victim of an unlikely bully.
A serious doping scandal shakes everyone's faith in a beloved icon. Everyone who once supported the fallen hero is now cutting off their symbolic yellow wristbands.
The boys use the game of Minecraft as a distraction to keep their parents from hurting each other.
Stan is addicted to the new Terrance and Phillip mobile game.
A weekend trip to experience the finer points of camping, fishing and blowing animals to smithereens is threatened by an erupting volcano.
Grandpa's sole birthday wish is for Stan to take part in his assisted suicide. Meanwhile, Mrs. Broflovski has organized a protest against the boys' favorite TV show, Terrance and Phillip.
When Sharon Marsh's Aunt Flo makes a monthly visit, she brings a mysterious pet fish for Stan.
When the citizens of South Park start exploding randomly, the mayor enlists Stan's dad, the resident geologist, to find a solution to the problem.
Stan's parents drag him along to Mr. Mackey's meteor shower party, where he is sent down into the basement to play with Pip, Butters and Dougie.
While the adults trapped at a time-share sales meeting, Stan is challenged by the best skier on the mountain.
When a famous psychic fails to help him exorcise Kenny from his body, Cartman and Chef travel to the moors of Scotland, where Chef's mom tries a little of her voodoo magic on him.
When a 32-year-old man claiming to be Stan from the future shows up in South Park, young Stan is forced to come to terms with the loser he will become.
A Mormon kid moves to South Park and it's up to Stan to kick his ass. But when Stan and his dad meet their new Mormon neighbors, they become fascinated with how genuinely nice they are.
After Wendy breaks up with Stan the boys take him to 'Raisins,' a local restaurant known for its great chicken wings and hot girls.
When the boys discover Terrance and Philip have called it quits, they'll go to any lengths to reunite the duo and recruit them for South Park's Earth Day festivities.
All the kids in South Park are glued to the TV, wild with anticipation to see the first trailer for the latest Terrance and Phillip movie.
Professor Chaos is frustrated when he realizes all of his diabolical plans to wreak havoc on South Park have already been done by The Simpsons.

The Brovlofski family is dealt a devastating blow when Ike's Canadian birth parents show up unexpectedly. When the townspeople decide to forego Christmas gifts and take up a collection to get Ike home to South Park, the boys are distraught.
The head of the World Canadian Bureau leads the country into a long and painful strike and the responsibility of brokering a settlement rests with the boys.
Someone plays an April Fool’s joke on the boys and it doesn’t go over well.
Randy’s obsession with the Food Network forces Sharon to explore a new interest of her own.
The Prince of Canada is about to take a Princess and Ike is obsessed with the Royal Wedding.
Kyle gets in on the ground floor of Cartman’s latest business venture, The Crack Baby Athletic Association.
When Ike hits puberty, he and Kyle start to grow apart. To save their relationship, Kyle takes Ike to see a live performance of Yo Gabba Gabba.
Stan is addicted to the new Terrance and Phillip mobile game.
Garrison wants to build a wall to keep out all of the undocumented immigrants.
It’s never been more challenging to be a PC Principal.
The children of South Park claim to have seen Mr. Garrison lurking around town. The townspeople are angry that the president is scaring their children.
Grandpa's sole birthday wish is for Stan to take part in his assisted suicide. Meanwhile, Mrs. Broflovski has organized a protest against the boys' favorite TV show, Terrance and Phillip.
